Even for commuting, Rampal said he limited his cab rides to trips to the airport. items.article: While most colds get better on their own, there are a list of circumstances where you need to see a GP As October arrives, many of us have already fallen victim to "winter" bugs such as the common cold. While being struck down with a cold is thoroughly miserable, the illness generally clears up within a week or so, and can most often be treated in the comfort of your own home. Typical symptoms include a blocked or runny nose, a cough, a sore throat , sneezing, fatigue and a general feeling of being under the weather , as well as a hoarse voice. Colds tend to develop gradually over the course of two or three days. Some sufferers may also experience a high temperature, a loss of taste or smell, muscle aches, and a sensation of pressure in the face or ears. Symptoms can persist for longer in young children, who may also become irritable, struggle with feeding and sleeping, breathe through their mouth, and be sick after coughing. As a rule, symptoms are at their worst midway through a cold, around days three to five. Towards the final days, most symptoms will have eased off, and your energy levels will have returned to normal.
